what_happened: mail-guard PreToolUse hook denies any agent Bash call containing a bare msmtp (or secret-tool) token, including read-only msmtp --version; the task's suggested msmtp --pretend/--serverinfo verification cannot be run by an agent. Did not bypass; recorded as a planning constraint and substituted an openssl STARTTLS handshake probe for the bridge TLS question.

nix eval showed the feature-overridden himalaya from the currently locked nixpkgs-unstable rev evaluates to the exact store path already installed, so pinning that rev as a dedicated input is a zero-rebuild, zero-behavior-change pin.

The mail-guard hook matches guarded tokens anywhere in a Bash command string, so a plan or module body quoting them cannot be written via a Bash heredoc and a derived commit message containing a bare guarded token would be denied; the plan was authored with the Write tool, phase names were worded to keep derived commit messages clear of the pattern, and the hazard is recorded in the plan Risks table for the implementer.
